verdict.rationale: Gemini's own Deep Research feature is documented as doing real-time research with Google Search as a default source, which covers answers grounded in current web results. Nothing in the pack shows the answers cite or link back to their sources. Missing for 10: documented citations or links back to sources in answers, web grounding for ordinary chat answers beyond Deep Research, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: By default, Gemini includes Google Search as a source for your research.
You can conduct in-depth and real-time research on almost any subject with Deep Research in Gemini Apps.
